text: Being here, I feel intellectually awakened by my surroundings. The clean, modern space outside the glass-walled meeting room suggests quiet anticipation, a setting ripe for ideas to incubate. Moving into the vivid display of R+D, I sense a celebration of inquiry and innovation. The juxtaposition of sterile quiet and vibrant inspiration stirs within me a curiosity—how do environments shape the development and exchange of knowledge? There’s a calm, yet a pulse of possibility thrumming under the surface.
